name: Primary Suite Addition: Preparing Your Home for Construction

step.name: Step 1: Site Preparation
step.text: This is where the magic begins. Expect your contractor to establish a secure work zone, potentially fencing off areas to protect children and pets, and setting up for material delivery and debris removal. This phase also includes protecting your existing landscaping and setting up temporary utilities if needed. It usually takes a few days, depending on the site.

step.name: Step 2: Foundation and Framing
step.text: Once the site is ready, the foundation will be laid, followed by the framing of your new addition. This is when you'll really start to see the shape and size of your new primary suite emerge. This stage can be noisy and dusty, but it’s exciting to watch. Inspections often happen after the foundation and framing are complete.

step.name: Step 3: Rough-Ins (Plumbing, Electrical, HVAC)
step.text: After framing, the necessary plumbing pipes, electrical wiring, and HVAC ducts will be installed within the walls and ceilings before they’re closed up. This phase also includes insulation. You'll have various tradespeople in and out, and inspections will be critical here before walls are covered.

step.name: Step 4: Exterior Finishes
step.text: Once the rough-ins are complete and inspected, the exterior of your primary suite will be finished, including siding, roofing, and windows. The goal is to make it blend seamlessly with your existing home, protecting the interior from the elements. This stage significantly impacts your home's curb appeal.

step.name: Step 5: Interior Finishes and Fixtures
step.text: This is the final stretch where the new space truly comes to life! Drywall goes up, floors are installed, and painting begins. Cabinets, fixtures, and trim are added, bringing your design vision to fruition. This phase involves a lot of detail work and multiple trades working to complete your new suite.

step.name: Step 6: Final Inspections and Walkthrough
step.text: Before final payment and occupancy, there will be a series of final inspections by local authorities to ensure everything meets code. Your contractor will also conduct a final walkthrough with you to address any last-minute items and ensure your complete satisfaction. This is your chance to review every detail. Affordable Home Remodeling focuses on clear communication throughout your primary suite addition. We're here to guide you through every step.
